keyFindings.description: The fence never runs on the edit it exists to stop. It reads docs/kubernetes.md (line 66), but CI runs it only in envoy-go, whose envoy_go filter (.github/workflows/ci.yaml:702-730) does not list docs/kubernetes.md, and .github/scripts/ci_job_reads.py has no RULES entry for it (compare reclaim_doc_test.go: ci.yaml:400, ci_job_reads.py:218). A pull request that edits only the claim list merges green and breaks the next envoy pull request. Fix: add 'docs/kubernetes.md' to envoy_go and the RULES entry for claims_doc_test.go.

The code side is the hand-typed list on line 51, so a fifth claim written in decide (exchange.go:389-398) and Introspection (introspect.go:21-45) passes the test while the doc's 'and no others' is false, the direction the test's own comment (lines 13-14) calls dangerous and the PR body says it catches. reclaim_doc_test.go rejects exactly this. Derive the issued set from code a new claim must touch (the Introspection struct's JSON tags minus active, scope, exp, client_id, jkt; or the keys decide writes into session.Extra in a named and a person run), and compare sorted slices with slices.Equal so a duplicated bullet also fails.

Anchoring on the hard-wrapped marker sentence costs flattenKeepingLines, lineEnds and the offset-to-line step (lines 36-39, 75-83, 144-160), and reuses the precedent's function name with a different return. Anchor on the one-line heading '#### The Dispatch identity the broker can issue' and read the first bullet list after it. Fixed in this pull request, per the no-deferral rule.

Fixed by the reviewer in 95adec64 (prose only): 'the bearer names nobody' holds only when dispatch_token_file holds a shared agent token, since optionalActor (packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/server.go:838-863) takes any other bearer as a service or personal token and bearerSessionActor keeps its owner; the operator-launched controller differs only in which file it reads; a session name an entry fixes is held with no expiry (ReserveSessions, oauthstore/exchange.go); 'Kubernetes token' made 'service-account token' so it does not read against the launcher Secret at kubernetes.md:1261.
